hero.name: Abilash George Thomas
hero.summary: Backend and data platform engineer with 15+ years of experience building scalable APIs, distributed systems, streaming pipelines, and cloud software across retail, media, utilities, and enterprise platforms.

contact.label: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA

bullets: Contributed to Apple Online Store, Apple TV+, and machine learning or data streaming platforms.
Designed and delivered scalable APIs and data flows for high-volume product surfaces.
Partnered with multiple teams on integration, support, and delivery work.
Maintained and supported field maintenance applications built on Microsoft .NET.
Handled bug fixes, disaster recovery analysis, and platform improvements.
Built analytics platforms and streaming pipelines for manufacturing, retail, and insurance clients.
Worked on data modeling, transformations, Hive UDFs/UDAFs, and REST services.
Led development of a digital rewards platform for VTC on AWS.
Built cloud data flows, schema design, OAuth 2.0 services, and mobile integration support.

projects.title: Apple Online Store
projects.description: Developed and supported scalable, secure RESTful APIs for Apple Online Store marketing and sales workflows using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC. Integrated backend services with partner modules, led design and code reviews, and handled on-call incidents and root-cause fixes.

projects.title: Apple TV+
projects.description: Built GraphQL and REST APIs for an integration platform connecting Apple TV+ media data sources across ingestion, transformation, and serving workflows. Designed data flows, developed Retool UI tooling, and built CI/CD pipelines with automated tests and containerized deployments in GCP while collaborating with product and data teams.

projects.title: Machine Learning and Data Streaming Platform
projects.description: Developed Java, Scala, and Python streaming and ingestion frameworks for anomaly detection and recommendation systems using Spark, Akka, Kafka, and Apache Iceberg. Added observability and operational tooling for a platform processing more than 700 TB annually; compaction reduced data volume by 50%+ and block count by 90%+.

projects.title: PG&E Field Maintenance Applications
projects.description: Maintained Microsoft .NET field maintenance applications in a production utilities environment. Led on-call support, outage response, customer issue triage, root-cause fixes, and disaster-recovery analysis, and built automated responses using Amazon Lex.

projects.title: TCS Analytics Programs
projects.description: Built Spark and Hadoop analytics platforms and real-time or batch ETL pipelines for Voltas, FLSmidth, Nielsen, and Allianz UK. Delivered data modeling, transformation, anomaly detection with PySpark, Hive UDFs and UDAFs, IoT integrations over MQTT, and OAuth 2.0-secured REST services.

projects.title: Tagbond Platform (VTC)
projects.description: Led end-to-end AWS development of Tagbond, a rewards and digital payments platform for VTC online training services. Designed scalable data flows and SQL/NoSQL schemas, built OAuth 2.0 REST services and mobile integrations, coordinated teams in India and the Philippines, and supported the platform after release.
